description:
Cloud teams spend a lot of time and money designing applications to withstand failure. Replication, versioning, snapshots, and infrastructure as code (IaC) keep applications available and cloud environments more resilient. The trouble starts when teams assume those same capabilities will also allow them to recover from a cyberattack.

Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, a new model designed for complex software engineering tasks that the company says can complete work more economically than larger models, as it seeks to expand the use of AI coding agents among enterprise developers.
